prerequisites: Hold a TKPK Level 1 certificate and K3 licence
Minimum junior secondary education (SLTP) or equivalent
Documented rope access working experience (typically at least 500 hours)
Medically fit for work at height, supported by a doctor’s statement
Final administrative requirements follow current Kemnaker rules — we check them with you on enrolment
outcomes: Select, rig, and check anchors and two-rope systems independently
Raise and lower loads with pulley systems
Perform advanced rescues: from ascent, past knots, and across edges
Supervise TKPK Level 1 technicians on site
Carry out periodic equipment inspection and keep work records

syllabus.title: Advanced rescue

syllabus.detail: Team briefings, permits to work, periodic equipment inspection, and records.

syllabus.detail: Written and practical examination under Kemnaker RI rules, the basis for issuing the certificate and K3 licence.

course.certificate: A TKPK Level 2 competency certificate and K3 licence issued by Indonesia’s Ministry of Manpower, plus an RAC training completion certificate. Validity and renewal follow Kemnaker rules.

sections.body:
## Who this programme is for

This programme is for TKPK Level 1 technicians who already work on rope regularly and are taking on rigging and responsibility for a teammate’s safety.

## Why a Kemnaker certificate

[Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016](https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1210/peraturan-menteri-ketenagakerjaan-nomor-9-tahun-2016) requires work at height to be carried out by competent workers. The certificate and K3 licence issued by Indonesia’s Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker RI) are nationally recognised proof of competence, checked by labour inspectors, contractors, and building managers alike. Read more about the [TKPK and TKBT schemes](/en/certification/).

## How we teach

Theory and practice run side by side: every topic is practised at height under instructor supervision and repeated until it is right. Training equipment is provided; trainees only need safety boots and work clothing.

## After you qualify

Once you have built up enough working experience, the next step is [TKPK Level 3](/en/tkpk-level-3-training/).

sections.title: Enrol or ask about the next course
